sub_answers.text: Artists competed independently from songs, meaning artists could be paired with any of the songs selected for the competition [d40165141s3p0]. Composers were required to agree that their song may be offered to an artist they did not originally write the song for [d40165141s3p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: How were votes weighted between jury panels, international juries, and public televoting across the selection rounds?
sub_answers.text: Results of each of the 12 shows were determined by a 50/50 combination of votes from a jury panel and public televoting [d40165141s3p0]. The jury votes in all shows consisted of a combination of a Lithuanian jury panel and an international jury panel, with Lithuanian panel members coming to consensus from the second show to the semi-final and international panel members assigning points individually [d40165141s3p0]. The public voted via telephone and SMS, and both jury and public rankings were converted to points from 1-8, 10 and 12 based on the number of competing artists in each show [d40165141s3p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What tie-breaking procedures and qualification criteria were specified for advancing between heats, semifinals, and the final?
sub_answers.text: Ties in the elimination shows and the semi-final were decided in favour of the entry that received the most votes from the public [d40165141s3p0]. In the final, a tie would be decided in favour of the entry that was awarded the most points by the jury [d40165141s3p0]. The eleventh show (semi-final) selected only the winning song from the remaining three songs, and the twelfth show (final) selected the winning artist-song combination from the remaining three artists [d40165141s3p0].

sub_answers.text: The national selection took place over 12 shows (twelve weeks) with artists competing independently from songs, allowing songs to be offered to different artists [d40165141s3p0]. The first show was a non-elimination jubilee concert; the second and third shows each featured ten artists with five eliminated in each of those shows [d40165141s3p0]. During each of the fourth to tenth shows one artist was eliminated from the artist stream while the remaining three artists advanced in the competition after those rounds [d40165141s3p0]. Starting from the fifth show, 16 potential Eurovision songs competed weekly and 13 of those songs were eliminated by the end of the tenth show, leaving three songs remaining [d40165141s3p0]. The eleventh show was the semi-final in which the single winning song was selected from the remaining three songs, and the twelfth show was the final where the winning artist–song combination was selected from the remaining three artists [d40165141s3p0].

sub_answers.text: Each show's results were determined by a 50/50 combination of votes from a jury panel and public televoting (telephone and SMS). [d40165141s3p0] The jury votes comprised a Lithuanian jury panel and an international jury panel, with the international panel members assigning points in descending order for their preferences. [d40165141s3p0] From the second to fifth shows the Lithuanian jury assigned scores from 1 to 10 to each artist, and from the sixth show onward the Lithuanian jury assigned points based on ranking. [d40165141s3p0] Public voting rankings and jury rankings were converted to points from 1-8, 10 and 12 and assigned based on the number of competing artists in each show, and in the final the Lithuanian and international panels voted together with each member awarding one set of points based on ranking. sub_answers.text: The competition consisted of 12 shows with artists progressing by eliminations: shows two and three each featured ten artists with five eliminated, shows four to ten eliminated one artist each leaving three artists to advance, the eleventh (semi-final) selected only the winning song from three remaining songs, and the twelfth (final) selected the winning artist-song combination from three artists. [d40165141s3p0] Ties in the elimination shows and the semi-final were decided in favour of the entry that received the most public votes. [d40165141s3p0] In the final, a tie would be decided in favour of the entry that was awarded the most points by the jury. [d40165141s3p0]
